related.title: Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新；Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究改以公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal; Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research centers on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Wairakei資源與歷史與EGS熱與連通，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以更新環境與階段證據為起點，設計一項能區分「既有蒸汽田與雙循環更新」與「公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare wairakei resources/history with egs heat/connectivity and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from renewal environment/stages and propose an observation distinguishing existing steamfields and binary-cycle renewal from public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles, including uncertainty.

related.title: 奧卡里亞地熱電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「閃發分率」與「地層壓密與下陷」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；奧卡里亞地熱電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Flash steam fraction" and "Formation compaction and subsidence" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦第一座開發熱水型熱儲的電廠與它六十年的後果：二級閃發、出力曲線、下陷與排熱；奧卡里亞地熱電站則以東非大裂谷的地熱基地：井口機組、全國電力占比、蒸汽管線的膨脹與鑽井成功率為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first plant on a hot-water reservoir and sixty years of consequences: second flash, output curves, subsidence and discharged heat; Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations centres on A geothermal base in the East African Rift: wellhead units, share of national power, expansion of steam mains and drilling success, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「單井出力」的模型移到奧卡里亞地熱電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「二氧化矽過飽和與結垢」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Output per well" to Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Silica supersaturation and scaling", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「閃發分率」與「地層壓密與下陷」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；奧卡里亞地熱電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Flash steam fraction" and "Formation compaction and subsidence" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations must be respecified.

related.title: 蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「閃發分率」與「地層壓密與下陷」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Flash steam fraction" and "Formation compaction and subsidence" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦第一座開發熱水型熱儲的電廠與它六十年的後果：二級閃發、出力曲線、下陷與排熱；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統則以世界最大的乾蒸汽田如何被抽乾又救回來：蒸汽耗率、壓力與產量、廢水回注與微震為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first plant on a hot-water reservoir and sixty years of consequences: second flash, output curves, subsidence and discharged heat; The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex centres on how the world's largest dry-steam field was drawn down and rescued: steam rate, pressure and output, wastewater injection and microseismicity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「單井出力」的模型移到蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「輸水管線的泵功」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Output per well" to The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pumping power of the water pipeline", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「閃發分率」與「地層壓密與下陷」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；蓋瑟斯地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Flash steam fraction" and "Formation compaction and subsidence" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of The Geysers Geothermal Power Complex must be respecified.
